items.title: Kitchen
items.body: An L-shaped layout with a peninsula, dark navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers, stone-look counters and a stainless steel range under a chimney hood and the sink under the window.

items.title: Primary Bedroom
items.body: The only vaulted ceiling in the house, with an exposed painted beam, sits over this room at the rear, with a window to mature trees, a double-door closet and new wall-to-wall carpet.

cover.house: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street on this East End bungalow, behind a concrete front walk. Outside are Hardi Plank siding, a new roof and a new driveway; inside, new wiring and breaker box, three-phase power and new plumbing. A fenced backyard with a covered garage sits behind the house, and the house has never flooded.

left.title: A portrait of the front rooms

main.title: Living Room
main.body: A tall double-pane window faces the street, and a clerestory window set high on the wall adds light. Recessed lights and a ceiling fan with a light are overhead. Wood-look floors run through the room with no thresholds, and a wide cased opening joins it to the Dining Area and on to the Kitchen.

side.title: Front Entry
side.body: The Craftsman-style front door has a divided-light window and opens straight into the Living Room from the covered porch.

main.title: Dining Area
main.body: Next to the breakfast bar, where two pendant lights hang over a stone-look counter, under a sputnik-style light of its own. A short hall off the Dining Area leads to the Primary, Bedroom 3 and the rear baths, keeping the private side of the house apart from the living spaces.

main.title: Breakfast Nook
main.body: Windows on two walls and a door to the backyard deck, beside the Kitchen and the pantry. A modern light fixture hangs overhead, and the Kitchen counter and backsplash wrap right up to the Nook.

main.title: Bedroom 2
main.body: At the front corner of the house, on the street side, with windows on two walls that look out to the neighborhood. The room has wall-to-wall carpet and a closet, and the door opens to a short hall, with the Living Room a few steps away.

side.title: Primary Closet
side.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides and more shelves above. The built-ins stay with the house.

main.title: Bedroom 3
main.body: A large window lights the room, with a reach-in closet beside the door and a ceiling fan with a light overhead. The doorway opens to the hall, which leads on to the hall bath. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary Bedroom.

side.title: Linen Shelves
side.body: Deep built-in linen shelves line the hall just outside the hall bath door, with room for towels and extra supplies.

main.title: Primary Bath
main.body: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity with drawers and cabinets. The walk-in shower is lined floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a sliding glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld on a slide bar.

side.title: Hall Bath
side.body: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath, which has a tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround and a window over the tub.

photos.title: Covered Garage
photos.body: A solid roof covers the space, with a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. The open concrete patio measures 8'11" x 25'11".

photos.title: Driveway
photos.body: A new driveway runs back beside the house, past the front lawn, to the covered garage and the open patio at the rear of the fenced lot.

floors.name: One floor
floors.body: The front door opens to the Living Room, and the Dining Area, the Kitchen and the Breakfast Nook run back from it in one open plan, with a pantry beside the Kitchen.
floors.body2: The Primary, Bedroom 2 and Bedroom 3 and both baths sit off the hall. The laundry is inside the house, and the covered garage and the open patio sit at the back of the fenced lot.

oh.write: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street on this East End bungalow, behind a concrete front walk. Inside, wood-look floors run from the Living Room through the Dining Area to the Kitchen and the Breakfast Nook, and a short hall off the Dining Area leads to the private side of the house, with both baths. The Primary Bedroom sits at the back under the only vaulted ceiling in the house, with an exposed painted beam. A fenced backyard holds the covered garage and an open concrete patio, a few steps from the deck off the Breakfast Nook.
